To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Relational Capital, as a form of Intellectual Capital, has a positive effect on consumers' eWOM communication in the context of bioeconomy health care services.

the intention to post electronic word of mouth communication in a social media support group for infertility treatment is explained by the motive of reciprocity, which in turn is explained by the Relational Capital of the consumer.

the consumers' motives for posting eWOM messages on the Social Media support groups are mainly related to the concept of reciprocity, as they are driven by the need to help other consumers in their search for health care services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the missing link between Relational Capital, Sustainable Bioeconomy and Health Care Services.
the identification of the motives for posting eWOM messages by women who have gone through IVF procedures.
the motives that lead women to post messages on Social Media groups and how this type of communication can be used by health care organizations in order to improve the services they offer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the eWOM communication in a Social Media support group has a strong impact on the consumers' intentions and, as such, it can influence the Relational Capital of a health care organization.
the eWOM communication is a missing link between Relational Capital, and Sustainable Bioeconomics, especially in the field of health care.
Relational Capital, as a component of the Intellectual Capital of an organization, has a significant impact on the organization's performance and sustainability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the consumers' motives are not only driven by their personal interests, but also by their moral obligation of helping others and the need of belonging to a supportive community.
Relational Capital is an important factor in the health care field and that eWOM communication is a powerful tool for consumers, as it can be used to improve their health care experience.
Relational Capital has a strong impact on the intention to post electronic word of mouth messages, which may lead to the development of a sustainable health care system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
organizations need to develop a relational capital strategy in order to be able to manage the eWOM communication of consumers, in order to achieve a sustainable bioeconomy.
health care organizations should be aware of the power of the Relational Capital, especially the eWOM communication, in the online social media platforms.
the Relational Capital, as a source of knowledge, can be a valuable resource for organizations in the bioeconomy field.
